name: Settlement Sum
title: Settlement Sum
text:
(a) In full and final settlement of all claims described above, {{paying_party_label}} shall pay {{receiving_party_label}} the sum of Rs. {{settlement_amount}}/- ({{settlement_amount_words}} only).
(b) The said sum is inclusive of interest, costs and all other claims, and no further sum is payable by either Party to the other in respect of the said disputes.

legal_basis.note: A promisee may dispense with or remit, wholly or in part, the performance of the promise made to him
Deduction of tax at source may arise on the character of the payment; the character of a settlement receipt must be determined before payment

authoring_note: Whether tax must be deducted at source depends on what the payment is FOR, not on what the document calls it: a payment that is in substance interest, rent, professional fees or salary attracts deduction even when it is labelled a settlement. The advocate should determine the character of the payment before it is made, because getting it wrong exposes the payer to the tax and to interest on it.
